comparison.objective: Remove a battery service plug before transferring busbars without bridging terminals; candidate selectively depins one contact from a connector housing.
comparison.physical_skill: PR primarily tests ordered plug removal and collision-safe busbar handling; its recorded plug is gravity-retained rather than a tang-release task. Candidate requires blade-guided tang depression maintained during wire withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the plug out, busbars in a tray, and no sequencing or bridging violation. Candidate requires rearward exit of one specified terminal, all neighbors retained, wire still crimped, and no bypass or damage.
comparison.reason: Removing a whole service plug as a safety prerequisite does not test internal contact depinning or sustained tang release.
